content: We experimented with four different classifiers, namely, support vector machine BIBREF18 , random forest, extra tree and naive bayes classifier BIBREF19 . Chi square feature selection algorithm is applied to reduces the size of our feature vector. For training our system classifier, we used Scikit-learn BIBREF19 .
